nodes.summary:
usage: corvint-lsp --experimental [--root ABSOLUTE_ROOT [--gopls ABSOLUTE_BINARY] [--tsserver ABSOLUTE_BINARY] [--ruby-lsp ABSOLUTE_BINARY] [--server SUFFIXES=ABSOLUTE_ARGV]... [--workspace-drift-guard]]
--experimental: required opt-in: this is an experimental stdio language server
--gopls: absolute gopls binary that serves .go documents (wrapped server observations)
--root: absolute workspace root; required with any language server
--ruby-lsp: absolute ruby-lsp binary for .rb .rake
--tsserver: absolute typescript-language-server binary, run as BINARY --stdio, for .ts .tsx .mts .cts .js .jsx .mjs .cjs
--workspace-drift-guard: refuse wrapped results once the workspace drifts from the bound revision; requires a language server
usage: corvint-lsp --experimental [--root ABSOLUTE_ROOT [--gopls ABSOLUTE_BINARY] [--tsserver ABSOLUTE_BINARY] [--ruby-lsp ABSOLUTE_BINARY] [--server SUFFIXES=ABSOLUTE_ARGV]... [--workspace-drift-guard]]
